   \dot\theta&=\omega \\
   \dot\omega&=\dfrac{(M+m)r_2-\cos\theta\,r_1}{\Delta} \\
   \dot F&=\dfrac{F_{\mathrm{cmd}}-F}{\tau_F}
   \end{aligned}

### soil_microbe_cn_stoichiometry.rst MISSING ['\\Delta R_{\\mathrm{CO_2}}', 'Rco_{2}']

### soil_moisture_respiration.rst MISSING ['\\Delta R_{\\mathrm{CO_2}}', 'Cs', 'Rco_{2}', 'ftheta']
   \boldsymbol{\chi}=[\theta,\,C]^\mathsf{T}.
   \begin{aligned}
   I&=k_I\tanh(u) \\
   D&=k_D[\theta-\theta_{fc}]_+^2 \\
   a(\theta)&=\exp\!\left[-\dfrac{1}{2}\left(\dfrac{\theta-\theta_{opt}}{\sigma_\theta}\right)^2\right] \\
   R_C&=k_cC^+a(\theta)
   \end{aligned}
   \begin{aligned}
   \dot\theta&=I+k_e(\theta_0-\theta)-D \\
   \dot C&=F_C-R_C
   \end{aligned}

### soil_nitrogen_n2o.rst MISSING ['NH_{4}', 'NO_{3}', 'O_{2}', 'rnit', 'rden', 'FN2O', 'nh_{4}', 'no_{3}', 'o_{2}']
   \boldsymbol{\chi}=[N_{H_4},\,N_{O_3},\,O_2]^\mathsf{T}.
   \begin{aligned}
   r_{nit}&=k_{nit}\dfrac{N_{H_4}^+}{K_{H_4}+N_{H_4}^++10^{-12}}\dfrac{O_2^+}{K_{O_2}+O_2^++10^{-12}} \\
   r_{den}&=k_{den}\dfrac{N_{O_3}^+}{K_{O_3}+N_{O_3}^++10^{-12}}\dfrac{K_i}{K_i+O_2^++10^{-12}} \\
   O_{2,\mathrm{eq}}&=\operatorname{clip}\!\left(O_{2,0}+k_O\tanh(u),0.05,1\right)
   \end{aligned}
   \begin{aligned}
   \dot N_{H_4}&=F_N-r_{nit}-k_LN_{H_4}^+ \\
   \dot N_{O_3}&=r_{nit}-r_{den}-k_LN_{O_3}^+ \\
   \dot O_2&=\dfrac{O_{2,\mathrm{eq}}-O_2}{\tau_O}-0.35r_{nit}-0.18r_{den}
   \end{aligned}

### two_mass_actuator_grounded_m2_linear_viscous.rst MISSING ['y_{2}', 'y_{1}', 'v_{1}', 'v_{2}', 'F_{1}', 'F_{2}', 'Ff']
   \boldsymbol{\chi}=[y_1,\,v_1,\,y_2,\,v_2,\,F_1,\,V_1]^\mathsf{T}.
   \begin{aligned}
   F_2&=k_p(y_1-y_2)+b_p(\dot y_1-\dot y_2) \\
   F_f&=0
   \end{aligned}
   \begin{aligned}
   \dot y_1&=v_1 \\
   \dot v_1&=\dfrac{F_1-F_2-k_{g1}y_1-k_1v_1}{m_1} \\
   \dot y_2&=v_2 \\
   \dot v_2&=\dfrac{F_2-k_{g2}y_2-k_2v_2-F_f}{m_2} \\
   \dot F_1&=V_1 \\
   \dot V_1&=\omega_a^2k_au-2\zeta_a\omega_aV_1-\omega_a^2F_1
   \end{aligned}

### two_mass_actuator_grounded_m2_lugre.rst MISSING ['y_{2}', 'y_{1}', 'v_{1}', 'v_{2}', 'F_{1}', 'F_{2}', 'zf', 'Ff']
   \boldsymbol{\chi}=[y_1,\,v_1,\,y_2,\,v_2,\,F_1,\,V_1,\,z_f]^\mathsf{T}.
   \begin{aligned}
   F_2&=k_p(y_1-y_2)+b_p(\dot y_1-\dot y_2) \\
   F_c&=\mu_kN,\qquad F_s=\mu_sN \\
   g(v_2)&=\max\!\left(F_c+(F_s-F_c)\exp\!\left[-\left|\dfrac{v_2}{v_s}\right|^\alpha\right],\varepsilon_g\right) \\
   \dot z_f&=v_2-\dfrac{\sigma_0|v_2|}{g(v_2)}z_f \\
   F_f&=\sigma_0z_f+\sigma_1\dot z_f+\sigma_2v_2
   \end{aligned}
   \begin{aligned}
   \dot y_1&=v_1 \\
   \dot v_1&=\dfrac{F_1-F_2-k_{g1}y_1-k_1v_1}{m_1} \\
   \dot y_2&=v_2 \\
   \dot v_2&=\dfrac{F_2-k_{g2}y_2-k_2v_2-F_f}{m_2} \\
   \dot F_1&=V_1 \\
   \dot V_1&=\omega_a^2k_au-2\zeta_a\omega_aV_1-\omega_a^2F_1 \\
   \dot z_f&=v_2-\dfrac{\sigma_0|v_2|}{g(v_2)}z_f
   \end{aligned}
